risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantified and provides specific debt, cash, repayment, and financing details, but it highlights dependence on subsidiary cash generation and uncertain access to additional funding. Management expresses confidence in near-term liquidity while acknowledging that working-capital support and alternative financing may not be available on acceptable terms. Long, technical sentences and standard forward-looking disclaimers somewhat reduce transparency.
